qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Sticky heritage with-profits and annuity back books provide legacy cash generation, but the open asset management franchise suffers from active fund fee compression and intense competition from low-cost passive indexers. Zero pricing power to raise management fees; high operating cost-to-income ratio (~75%) and sub-hurdle multi-cycle ROIC.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (Rejected – G3 Moat & Pricing). UK savings and investment manager burdened by a capital-intensive legacy with-profits book and an active mutual fund business facing structural fee compression from passive vehicles. Lacks an enduring economic moat or pricing power.
qualitative.evidence: M&G manages £376B in AUMA across asset management and life/with-profits funds. Active asset management operating profits remain constrained (£280M) with a ~75% cost-to-income ratio. Open-ended mutual funds face relentless price competition and substitution from low-cost ETFs and passive solutions, precluding inflation-protected pricing power.
